3rd game in our best Sudoku series on Steam is available for download.

 100 killer Sudoku Killer puzzles
 Level's progress save
 Beautiful minimalist design, multiple color themes

https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/u/61746565/cyrillic.jpg

Changelog:

 added Cyrillic characters as achievements
 achievements system rebalanced, many of them can be found in first chapters now 
 levels with achievements are now visible on map, when overlapping specific level button with mouse
 B - turns on/off background animations
 S - turns on/off windowed mode
